summary: The economy unexpectedly shed 23,000 jobs in July, the first monthly decline since February, cooling rate-hike bets and pulling Treasury yields lower. The Fed's July hold came in a 9-3 decision — the first three-member dissent since 2016 — keeping policy uncertainty front and center. Iran's publication of a restrictive draft plan for the Strait of Hormuz has kept oil and geopolitical risk in play, capping the risk-on mood.
tweet: A shock jobs loss crushed hike bets and lifted equities, but Iran's Strait of Hormuz draft plan is keeping geopolitical risk alive and gold bid.
